user.title: Add GridWorks Connector
user.description: Create a shadow-only resource. No equipment commands are supported.

menu.title: Commission your resource
menu.description: {counts}. Add as many meaningful channels as needed. Finish requires a temperature channel with limits.

menu_options.signal: Add a meter, service, mode or context signal

temperature.title: Add a thermal-state channel
temperature.description: Choose an existing entity. For climate entities, enter the temperature attribute. Limits must use the selected unit.

data.attribute: Attribute (leave empty to use entity state)
data.label: Label

signal.title: Add a meter, service, mode or context signal
signal.description: Choose the signal's actual meaning. A thermostat call is requested service, not confirmed delivery. Mode time constraints use UTC epoch milliseconds.

data.label: Label
data.attribute: Attribute (leave empty to use entity state)

mode.title: Define an opaque mode
mode.description: A mode names a discrete controllable configuration. Availability is unknown unless declared or mapped. This does not control equipment.

data.label: Label
data.state_value: Corresponding local mode state (optional; stays local)

meter.title: Define an electrical boundary
meter.description: Describe the plant/generator coverage. Add a parent only for an overlapping submeter; parent and child must never be summed twice.

service.title: Define a thermal service
service.description: Delivery feedback is optional. Missing feedback remains unknown.

site.title: Site context
site.description: Location is shared only with the configured test peer for weather-source review. Leave unavailable fields empty.

transport.title: Choose the shadow peer
transport.description: Embedded demonstration stays inside HA. External MQTT requires approved test credentials and draft-protocol support; it is not automatically compatible with production GridWorks.

broker.title: Approved test broker
broker.description: Distinct exact topics only. TLS is mandatory outside loopback. Certificate/key paths refer to protected files on HA, not your workstation. Never paste private keys.

data.test_endpoint_confirmed: This is an authorized test-only endpoint

weather.title: Review proposed weather sources
weather.description: Choose primary and optional backups, then explicitly confirm. Test-catalog entries are not live provider discovery.

data.confirmed: I confirm these sources represent this site

remove.title: Remove a channel
remove.description: Re-adding a replaced sensor creates a new channel identity.

finish.title: Commissioning incomplete
finish.description: Return to the menu and add a temperature channel with valid limits and complete transport configuration.

edit.title: Edit a commissioned definition
edit.description: Changing a source creates a new channel identity; changing its label or limits preserves identity with a new configuration revision.

error.invalid_mapping: Check the entity, units, limits and referenced identities. No changes were saved.
error.incomplete: Add at least one temperature channel with explicit lower and upper limits.
error.weather_not_ready: Weather review is available after setup when a peer has proposed sources. Return to the commissioning menu.
